request.text: One small living water blob lands on soft damp earth after a short hop. Immediate rounded low-mid liquid plop, a tiny wet splat and a quick soft wobble settling within 0.25 seconds. Friendly, close and dry game SFX, compact and restrained. A single impact only. No repeated bouncing, big splash, dripping sequence, mud suction, voice, music, ambience, chime or reverb.
